sources.topic: SET_TSK_ATTR signature, calling task and nine writable attributes
Request masks, self-control exclusions, busy lamp and shift directives
Priority ordering, time-slice units and pendant motion directive

implementation.settings: Nine exact INTEGER policies validated before updates; empty source name selects uniquely registered calling root including linked routines
implementation.scheduling: Stable lower-number-first round order and ceil(timeslice_ms/quantum_ms) checkpoint advances per turn; all runnable bindings retain turns and clock advances once per round
implementation.requests: Distinct command/error origins plus explicit TP-enable/shift notifications; suppress new requests only and preserve history/notifications
implementation.trace: Bounded caller-rooted source checkpoint records; defensive settings/trace properties; trace resets on begin and settings persist across runs/renames
implementation.directives: Seven pre-declaration task directives with unique named mask flags, numeric literals and argument-free flags
implementation.cli: Project --trace-out atomically exports detached versioned observations, including partial traces on execution failure
implementation.metadata: NOBUSY/TPMOTION remain readable capability data; applied settings override informational bind metadata

portable_choices.bounds: Priority 1..99, slice 1..1000 ms, trace limit 1..10000; flags 0/1; unsupported masks reject
portable_choices.statuses: 0 success, 1 unknown task, 2 unknown attribute/invalid value, 3 read-only/unavailable or ambiguous self/foreign active scheduler
portable_choices.defaults: One checkpoint per turn without an applied slice, ordering priority 50, enabling trace supplies limit 1000
portable_choices.persistence: Settings/traces/continuations omitted from value-state snapshots; CLI trace JSON is a separate observation artifact

retained_guards: Bare PAUSE/ABORT, runtime failures and host stop bypass persistent request masks
Exact types, initialization, output references and transitive FOR-counter protection
Budgets fixed at turn start; sleep/pause/failure/completion ends a turn; step/cycle limits remain
Source identity, numeric task order, linked ownership and rename state retention
unresolved: Native preemption, CPU slicing, priority starvation, interrupts and status enums
Native lock-group eligibility, physical lamps, shift/pendant acquisition and motion
Native trace format/capacity, suspended execution persistence and strict mode
